title: Curriculum and Instruction in Secondary School English
description: Prepares students to instruct and assess secondary English language arts. Explores a variety of teaching and assessment strategies, resources and current research into the challenges and possibilities of teaching English language arts.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of EDCI 747, ED-B 753.
May be offered in English or French.
